definition: A private bedroom or dressing room in an elegant home.
author: Frances Hodgson Burnett
quote: They found the rose-colored brocade boudoir and the hole in the cushion the mouse had left, but the mice had grown up and run away and the hole was empty.
example_sentence: She turned the spare room into a velvet boudoir.
